profile_text: Specializing in corporate restructuring and turnaround management services, this consulting firm has experienced rapid growth, with a 242.9% increase in employees since its baseline. Its expertise in navigating complex business transformations has driven its expansion, catering to companies in need of strategic revitalization. As a result, it has earned a reputation as a trusted advisor in the professional services sector, with a team of 24 employees as of 2024.
